title: Dataplex Data Docs Get Custom Instructions
summary: Dataplex now allows developers to provide custom instructions when generating data documentation. This new optional field offers more control over the documentation process.
details: The `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataDocumentationSpec` schema has been extended with a new optional `customInstructions` field. This string field, with a maximum length of 2,048 characters, enables users to specify tailored guidance for how data documentation should be generated, potentially improving relevance and accuracy.
